biography:
Why do I get up in the morning? I believe IT is at the epicentre of businesses and I am keen to demonstrate how the right IT infrastructure can drive your business forward. 

Having worked with industry leaders such as BT Global, Equinix, Iron Mountain Data Centers, nLighten and now Redcentric Data Centres, my subject matter expertise span a wide range of IT specific areas such as telecommunication, data centre and colocation, IT security, IT performance optimisation and cloud technology adoption. 

With this in place, my primary focus is guiding and steering businesses through the rapid and dynamic change we are all experiencing and supporting them to ensure your IT infrastructure delivers competitive advantage, increases business value and fosters ongoing innovation. 

This is ever more important as key industry trends such as the Internet of Things, big data and cloud technology continue to dominate the IT landscape and CIOs take a much broader approach, driving business transformation, innovating for competitive advantage and acting as key strategic partners to the CEO and the wider organization. 

More organisations are looking for increased reliability, better cost optimisation, more autonomy, lower latency, and the ability to innovate while keeping the lights on. These goals now require a much more holistic approach to innovative technologies such as AI, Machine Learning and IOT and the ability to leverage them effectively. Redcentric’s growing data centre network will ensure they have the resilient infrastructure, bandwidth and low latency necessary to do this. 

I am actively seeking to help organizations overcome their IT transformation challenges, delivering critical IT deployment solutions that enable leading enterprises to stay at the forefront of technology innovation, and ultimately remain competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace. 

Simplicity is everything…

This philosophy guides everything I do. So what does this mean for you and your business? What opportunities or challenges does it present? Is it worth your time, consideration and ultimately resource? This approach ensures that the client is informed, is able to understand the environment conditions and therefore is able to see clearly the value in any solution I recommend.

The key to success is not just about harnessing technology, it’s about finding the right partner to do it with!

Think I might be able to help? Get in touch, I would love to show you how I can make this happen with Redcentric Data Centres.
